name: fullstack-playbook
description: Shortcut scripts for the React apps. Each app keeps its own node_modules and package-lock.json.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix react/login-app && npm install --prefix react/task-manager && npm install --prefix react/foundation/foundation-app
scripts.lint:all: npm run lint --prefix react/login-app && npm run lint --prefix react/task-manager && npm run lint --prefix react/foundation/foundation-app
